records.claim_text: The frozen task produces a 24-hour-ahead load forecast that is consumed by a battery peak-shaving dispatch evaluation; forecasting is an input to the decision task, not the terminal objective.
records.claim_scope: 8 fixed office buildings; Train/Validation/Test protocol; DOEF pipeline
records.allowed_wording: 预测不是终点：24 小时前瞻负荷预测服务于电池削峰决策。
records.prohibited_wording: The system has validated electricity-cost savings, carbon reduction, or lower energy consumption.
records.notes: The evidence supports peak-demand reduction only, not tariff savings, carbon reduction, or energy-use reduction.

records.claim_text: On the frozen 8-building Test aggregate, XGBoost has slightly lower normalized RMSE than LightGBM (0.216751 versus 0.216942) but higher normalized decision regret (0.117534 versus 0.116127).
records.claim_scope: 8 fixed office buildings; Test; XGBoost versus LightGBM
records.allowed_wording: 更低的预测 RMSE 不必然带来更好的储能决策：冻结 Test 结果中，XGBoost 的 RMSE 略优，决策 regret 却更差。
records.prohibited_wording: Forecast accuracy is irrelevant, or all more accurate models make worse decisions.
records.notes: The RMSE gap is small and this is a project-specific counterexample, not proof that forecast accuracy never matters.

records.claim_text: Phase 8 evaluates 11 predeclared DayWeek/LightGBM weights on Validation and freezes each building's weight by mean daily regret versus a non-deployable Oracle; for Hog_office_Joey, forecast-MAE selection chooses w=0.6 while decision-regret selection chooses w=0.3.
records.claim_scope: 8 fixed office buildings; example: Hog_office_Joey; Validation only; DayWeek/LightGBM ensemble
records.allowed_wording: DOEF 不只按预测误差选融合权重，而是在 Validation 上按储能决策 regret 冻结权重。
records.prohibited_wording: Weights were tuned on Test, or the Oracle is deployable.
records.notes: The Joey weights are an illustrative frozen example; Oracle is hindsight-only and non-deployable.

records.claim_text: The benchmark fixes 8 heterogeneous office buildings using Train-only morphology after frozen eligibility filtering from 296 office candidates, of which 82 pass the frozen quality rules.
records.claim_scope: 8 pre-selected heterogeneous office buildings; Train-only building selection; later Validation/Test evaluation; multi-model benchmark
records.allowed_wording: 在 296 个办公候选中按冻结质量规则筛到 82 个，再仅用 Train 期形态预选 8 栋异质办公建筑。
records.prohibited_wording: DOEF generalizes to unseen buildings, zero-shot transfers, or performs domain adaptation.
records.notes: This is multi-building evaluation across fixed buildings, not unseen-building transfer.

records.claim_text: DOEF v1.0 is formally named Decision-Oriented Ensemble Forecasting and computes w_b·LightGBM + (1-w_b)·DayWeek for a 24-hour-ahead forecast, with w_b frozen per building by Validation decision regret before battery dispatch evaluation.
records.claim_scope: 8 fixed office buildings; Validation selection; Test evaluation; DayWeek + LightGBM → DOEF → battery dispatch
records.allowed_wording: DOEF v1.0（Decision-Oriented Ensemble Forecasting）把因果预测、决策导向融合和电池削峰评估连成一条冻结流程。
records.prohibited_wording: DOEF is a new LightGBM model, an end-to-end differentiable optimizer, or a deployed production system.
records.notes: The pipeline is integrated for evaluation; it is not end-to-end differentiable training and does not claim online deployment.

records.claim_text: On the frozen 8-building Test aggregate, DOEF reduces mean normalized MAE from 0.147338 for LightGBM to 0.137970, a relative improvement of 6.3585%.
records.claim_scope: 8 fixed office buildings; Test; DOEF v1.0 versus LightGBM
records.allowed_wording: 在冻结的 8 栋建筑 Test 汇总上，DOEF 相对 LightGBM 的 normalized MAE 改善 6.36%。
records.prohibited_wording: DOEF beats all forecasting methods everywhere or is state of the art.
records.notes: One fixed Test month per building; the result is not evidence of universal or unseen-building performance.

records.claim_text: On the frozen 8-building Test aggregate, DOEF reduces mean normalized decision regret from 0.116127 for LightGBM to 0.111929, a relative improvement of 3.6147%, with 6 building wins, 2 ties, and 0 losses.
records.claim_scope: 8 fixed office buildings; Test; DOEF v1.0 versus LightGBM
records.allowed_wording: DOEF 相对 LightGBM 的 normalized decision regret 改善 3.61%，建筑级结果为 6 胜、2 平、0 负。
records.prohibited_wording: DOEF beats every method on every building, or the improvement is monetary savings.
records.notes: Regret is defined against the non-deployable Oracle under the frozen battery protocol; this is not monetary regret.

records.claim_text: Across the 8 fixed Test buildings, DOEF's mean whole-window peak reduction is 6.4423%; the building-level minimum is -1.0170%, so the frozen evidence includes a degradation case.
records.claim_scope: 8 fixed office buildings; Test; DOEF v1.0
records.allowed_wording: DOEF 的 8 栋建筑平均削峰率为 6.44%，同时如实保留最差建筑 -1.02% 的负结果。
records.prohibited_wording: DOEF always reduces peak demand, or every building improves.
records.notes: Whole-window peak reduction is not daily-average peak reduction; one building is negative.

records.claim_text: The frozen Phase 3 selection table represents 1,578 building series; 296 are office candidates.
records.claim_scope: project selection universe; not applicable; dataset
records.allowed_wording: 项目冻结的 BDG2 选择表覆盖 1,578 栋建筑序列，其中 296 栋为办公候选。
records.prohibited_wording: BDG2 universally has exactly 1,578 buildings.
records.notes: The 1,578 count is scoped to this repository's frozen selection table.

records.claim_text: Forecasts use only causally available load-history and calendar features for a 24-hour horizon; target leakage and weather features are excluded in the frozen protocol.
records.claim_scope: 8 fixed office buildings; all splits; forecast components
records.allowed_wording: 24 小时前瞻预测只使用因果可得的负荷历史与日历特征。
records.prohibited_wording: The system uses real-time future weather or future target values.
records.notes: This does not claim the feature set is optimal or exhaustive.

records.claim_text: All model and ensemble choices were frozen using Validation only; Test is evaluation-only and cannot promote an algorithm.
records.claim_scope: 8 fixed office buildings; Validation selection; Test evaluation; all selected models and ensemble weights
records.allowed_wording: 所有模型与融合选择均只用 Validation 冻结，Test 仅用于评估。
records.prohibited_wording: The Test set was pristine, completely untouched, or never viewed.
records.notes: Historical Test results had been viewed; the safe statement concerns non-use for selection, not pristine visibility.

records.claim_text: A frozen building-level paired bootstrap of DOEF minus LightGBM normalized mean decision regret uses 10,000 resamples and yields point estimate -0.004198 with 95% interval [-0.006850, -0.001719].
records.claim_scope: 8 fixed office buildings; Test; DOEF v1.0 minus LightGBM
records.allowed_wording: 以建筑为重采样单位的冻结 bootstrap 区间仍位于 0 以下。
records.prohibited_wording: This proves universal statistical superiority across buildings.
records.notes: Only 8 building units are available; the bootstrap quantifies uncertainty within this fixed scope.

records.claim_text: The explicit DOEF v1.0 formula reproduces all 5,760 frozen Phase 8 ensemble predictions with maximum absolute difference 0.0 kW.
records.claim_scope: 8 fixed office buildings; Test; DOEF v1.0
records.allowed_wording: DOEF v1.0 公式对 5,760 个冻结预测实现零差异复现。
records.prohibited_wording: A new independent experiment reproduced the result.
records.notes: This is prediction identity, not a fresh model rerun or independent replication.

records.claim_text: Forecast-driven daily battery schedules are evaluated on realized load under frozen capacity, power, efficiency, SOC, and daily-reset constraints.
records.claim_scope: 8 fixed office buildings; Test; all forecast-driven controllers
records.allowed_wording: 所有预测方法在同一冻结电池约束下比较，实现从预测到真实削峰结果的闭环评价。
records.prohibited_wording: The battery controller has been deployed in real buildings.
records.notes: The protocol is a fixed offline evaluation, not a field deployment.

records.claim_text: Peak-reduction conclusions must retain method, building, split, whole-window/daily scope, and aggregation labels; CatBoost's frozen Test mean is -24.4824% while its median is 4.8209%.
records.claim_scope: 8 fixed office buildings; Test; CatBoost example
records.allowed_wording: 削峰率必须同时说明方法、建筑范围和聚合口径；均值与中位数可能给出相反印象。
records.prohibited_wording: Peak reduction is one universal scalar or CatBoost uniformly increases peaks.
records.notes: The extreme mean is driven by a documented low-load building case; do not collapse it to one unlabeled scalar.

records.claim_text: Negative or mixed frozen outcomes are retained and are not used to revise the Validation-frozen algorithm after Test evaluation.
records.claim_scope: Hog_office_Rolando and 8-building follow-up; Validation selection; Test reporting; robust and peak-aware supporting experiments
records.allowed_wording: 负结果不被隐藏，也不用于 Test 后反向改选算法。
records.prohibited_wording: Every attempted method improved Test performance.
records.notes: These experiments are supporting falsification evidence, not DOEF components.

records.claim_text: For Hog_office_Rolando Test, the Validation-selected robust LightGBM configuration (lambda=0.5) has mean regret 20.4635 kW versus 11.1274 kW for deterministic LightGBM.
records.claim_scope: Hog_office_Rolando; Test after Validation selection; robust versus deterministic LightGBM
records.allowed_wording: 稳健优化实验是负结果：Test mean regret 由 11.1274 kW 恶化至 20.4635 kW。
records.prohibited_wording: Robust optimization improved Test performance.
records.notes: Single-building negative supporting experiment; not part of DOEF v1.0.

records.claim_text: Raw meter observations are kWh per one-hour interval; dispatch quantities are interpreted as interval-average kW, while battery capacity and SOC remain kWh.
records.claim_scope: all buildings; all splits; data and battery semantics
records.allowed_wording: 一小时时间步下，负荷读数按区间能量解释，调度功率用 kW，电池容量与 SOC 用 kWh。
records.prohibited_wording: kWh and kW are interchangeable units.
records.notes: Numerical values coincide only because delta-t equals one hour.

records.claim_text: The frozen evaluation contains one fixed future Test month per building; Test did not select models or weights but historical Test results had been viewed.
records.claim_scope: 8 fixed office buildings; one fixed Test month per building; all final methods
records.allowed_wording: Test 不参与选择，但评估范围仅为每栋建筑一个固定未来月份，且不能称为从未查看。
records.prohibited_wording: Completely untouched pristine Test set or broad temporal generalization.
records.notes: This limits temporal generalization and pristine-Test wording.

records.claim_text: DOEF uses frozen per-building Validation-selected weights rather than one universal ensemble weight; the Joey decision-selected LightGBM weight is 0.3.
records.claim_scope: 8 fixed office buildings; Validation; DOEF ensemble
records.allowed_wording: DOEF 使用逐建筑冻结权重，而不是一个全局固定权重。
records.prohibited_wording: DOEF always uses w=0.3.
records.notes: Do not generalize Joey's value to other buildings.

records.claim_text: The Phase 9.1 invariance audit confirms the reporting definition is byte-identical in values to the frozen Phase 8 ensemble prediction over 5,760 samples.
records.claim_scope: 8 fixed office buildings; Test; DOEF v1.0
records.allowed_wording: 报告中的 DOEF 定义与冻结 Phase 8 预测逐值一致。
records.prohibited_wording: All repository lineage issues are repaired.
records.notes: This does not repair the separately documented historical canonical-loader parent-hash caveat.
